title: The month onion prices jumped across India
summary: In June 2015, the median onion market moved +25.0% in a month, 3.6 standard deviations from the usual for that month.
why_selected: Chosen automatically: the 3.6σ seasonal move is among the largest on record for onion, across 582 reporting markets.

evidence.observations: monthly medians of daily modal prices; markets need ≥5 reports in both months
caveats: Many market points are district centres, not mandi gates.
Modal prices are reported aggregates, not transaction offers.

scenes.headline: June 2015
scenes.caption: Onion prices across 582 markets that reported in both May 2015 and June 2015.

scenes.headline: Median move +25.0%
scenes.caption: The typical market's onion price jumped 25.0% in one month. 85% of markets moved the same way.

scenes.headline: 3.6× the usual swing
scenes.caption: Compared with the same month in every earlier year on record, this move was 3.6 standard deviations from normal.

scenes.headline: Gujarat
scenes.caption: Neighbouring markets moved together: the 24 reporting markets in Gujarat had a median change of +50.3%.

scenes.headline: Barwala
scenes.caption: Barwala (Haryana), one of the busiest markets among the biggest movers: monthly median ₹950 → ₹1,650 per quintal (+73.7%).

scenes.headline: What this does and doesn't show
scenes.caption: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.

conclusion: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.
